sub_graphs.title: KZG Commitment to Versioned Hash Conversion
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of converting KZG commitments to versioned hashes for blob transactions

nodes.label: KZG Commitment Received
nodes.description: System has received a 48-byte KZG commitment from a blob transaction

nodes.label: Hash KZG Commitment
nodes.description: Compute SHA256 hash of the 48-byte KZG commitment

nodes.label: Prepend Version Byte
nodes.description: Prepend version byte 0x01 to the truncated commitment hash to create versioned hash

nodes.label: Versioned Hash Ready
nodes.description: Versioned hash is computed and ready for inclusion in blob transaction

external_entities.name: Blob Transaction
external_entities.description: Type-3 transaction containing blob data and KZG commitments

sub_graphs.title: KZG Point and Field Element Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation process for KZG cryptographic elements

nodes.label: 48-Byte Input Received
nodes.description: Untrusted 48-byte input received for G1 point validation

nodes.label: Check Point at Infinity
nodes.description: Check if input is the G1 point at infinity (0xc0 + 47 zero bytes)

nodes.label: Validate G1 Point
nodes.description: Validate G1 point using BLS proof-of-possession verification

nodes.label: G1 Point Valid
nodes.description: G1 point has passed validation and is safe for cryptographic operations

nodes.label: G1 Point Invalid
nodes.description: G1 point failed validation - cryptographic operation rejected

nodes.label: 32-Byte Field Element Received
nodes.description: Untrusted 32-byte input received for BLS field element conversion

nodes.label: Field Element Valid
nodes.description: 32-byte input is valid BLS field element

nodes.label: Field Element Invalid
nodes.description: Input exceeds BLS modulus - assertion failure

edges.label: Point at infinity accepted without further validation

external_entities.name: Untrusted Byte Input
external_entities.description: External source providing raw byte data for KZG operations

sub_graphs.title: KZG Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic verification of KZG proofs using pairing checks

nodes.label: Proof Verification Inputs Received
nodes.description: All inputs for proof verification received: commitment (48B), z (32B), y (32B), proof (48B)

nodes.label: Validate Input Lengths
nodes.description: Assert correct byte lengths for all proof verification inputs

nodes.label: Convert to Cryptographic Types
nodes.description: Convert raw bytes to KZGCommitment, BLSFieldElement (z, y), and KZGProof

nodes.label: Cryptographic Types Ready
nodes.description: All inputs validated and converted to cryptographic types

nodes.label: Compute X - z
nodes.description: Compute X_minus_z using G2 operations with trusted setup parameter KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL_1

nodes.label: Compute P - y
nodes.description: Compute P_minus_y using G1 point arithmetic with commitment and y value

nodes.label: Perform Pairing Check
nodes.description: Execute BLS12-381 pairing operation and final exponentiation to verify P - y = Q * (X - z)

nodes.label: KZG Proof Valid
nodes.description: Pairing check succeeded - proof verified, polynomial evaluation is correct

nodes.label: KZG Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Pairing check failed - proof rejected, potential data integrity violation

edges.label: Begin G2 computation with trusted setup

external_entities.name: Blob Verification Caller
external_entities.description: System component requesting KZG proof verification for blob data

ambiguities.text: The behavior when validate_kzg_g1 fails is not explicitly defined - whether it raises an exception or returns a sentinel value
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validation failure raises an exception that propagates to caller, rejecting the operation

ambiguities.text: The truncation length for SHA256 hash in kzg_commitment_to_versioned_hash is not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard versioned hash format: 1 byte version + 31 bytes of hash = 32 bytes total

implicit_assumptions.description: The trusted setup parameter KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL_1 is assumed to be generated correctly and not compromised
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised trusted setup would allow forging valid KZG proofs for arbitrary data, completely breaking blob data integrity

implicit_assumptions.description: Attacker cannot efficiently compute discrete logarithms in BLS12-381 groups
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could forge KZG commitments and proofs, allowing invalid blob data to be accepted

implicit_assumptions.description: BLS12-381 pairing operations are implemented correctly in underlying cryptographic library
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Implementation bugs could cause valid proofs to be rejected or invalid proofs to be accepted
